profile.headline: Software Engineer @ SoFi | Ex-BlackRock
profile.summary: Software Engineer currently residing in San Francisco. My interests include software engineering, data science, finance, and economics.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description: Frontend software engineer building Aladdin Trader, a new institutional fixed income trading interface.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Fullstack software engineer building Aladdin Trader, a new institutional fixed income trading interface.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Machine Learning engineer working alongside quantitative researchers developing signals for systematic active equity investment strategies.

- Backend software engineer designing a greenfield high-scale Forex microservice for next-gen portfolio management ecosystem and scaling backend trading system data pipelines for higher request throughout and lower latency.

positions.title: Computer Modeling Researcher
positions.description:
Researcher under Professor Carlo Sequin developing a new open-source 3D-manifold topological CAD modeling tool called JIPCAD (Joining Interactive Graphics and Procedural Modeling for CAD).

Implemented generalized expression-based shape generators, updated internal declarative shape-generation language, and stress tested current software implementations.

positions.title: Undergraduate Student Instructor
positions.description:
Undergraduate Student Instructor for the "Principles & Techniques of Data Science" (Data 100) upper-divisional course at UC Berkeley for the Fall 2020 semester, supporting over 1300+ students through discussions, labs, exam prep & grading, and course material development.

Covered material on Python, Pandas, Scikit-learn, Linear Algebra, Probability Theory, feature engineering, dimensionality reduction, supervised and unsupervised learning algorithms, etc.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Major in Data Science, Minor in Computer Science, Emphasis in Econometrics
